title: Palabras council run manifest
description: manifest.json of one council bundle (content/council/<run_id>/). Written offline by tools/council, consumed by the C# council importer. The manifest is the audit record of a run: which models were asked, which failed, and the exact hash of candidates.jsonl. Schema keywords stay inside the subset supported by tools/content-lint/validate.js so the CLI and the image agree on the contract without a second JSON Schema library.

schema.description: Format marker. A future v2 is a new const, never a silent reinterpretation.

run_id.description: Run identifier, also the bundle directory name. By convention a ULID, and deliberately not pinned to one alphabet: the value must stay path-safe (no slash, no dot-dot, no spaces).

mode.description: propose adds new keys only; rework may version an existing word.

prompt_version.description: Prompt file versions used for this run. Prompts change by new file, never by edit, so these values are the A/B key.

style_guide_sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of content/style-guide.md at run time; ties prompt output to the rules it was given.

request.description: What was asked for. All fields are optional because a rework run is driven by feedback rows, not by a topic request.

models.description: One entry per requested model, including models that failed: a run with reduced confidence must still name what was lost.

reduced_confidence.description: True when either phase completed with fewer models than requested; the reviewer UI shows it and the importer stores it on every word.

counts.description: candidates must equal the candidates.jsonl line count; dropped is audit only.

candidates_sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the raw candidates.jsonl bytes, including the trailing newline. Required for status ok; verified before any write.

status.description: failed = the run did not reach the bundle contract (for example COUNCIL_MIN_MODELS was not met). A failed bundle carries no importable candidates.

error.description: Optional operator-facing reason for status=failed or reduced_confidence.

created_at.description: Run creation instant. The importer compares it with the newest reviewer revision, so a rework older than her edit is refused.

id.description: provider:model, e.g. anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5 or openrouter:vendor/model. Lower-case provider keeps the roster greppable; the model part keeps the provider's own casing.

invalid_count.description: Structured-output lines that failed schema validation. Counted, never imported.

error.description: Failure detail for the losing phase. Never contains prompt or key material.
